text: Delivered as a Mermaid flowchart with short notes before or after it, covering both the live sync path and the rebuild.

Live path from a committed change to products, through the CDC connector and the catalog.products topic, to a new indexer and the index. Only active products are indexed; deletes and draft or archived changes remove the document.
Ordering protection: each write is versioned with commit_lsn under the 'at least stored' rule, and version conflicts are counted as stale rather than treated as errors.

Kafka offsets are committed only after the index acknowledges the writes. Transient failures are retried with backoff from 1 s, doubling, capped at 60 s, without skipping. Invalid documents go to catalog.products.dlq with an alert, and processing continues.
Retained-WAL handling: alert at 20 GB; at 50 GB the slot is dropped and recovery requires a full rebuild.

Zero-downtime rebuild behind the products alias: a snapshot copy at up to 5,000 rows/s, catch-up on the changes made during the copy, and an atomic alias switch only when lag is under 5 s and the document count is within 0.5% of active rows.
The old index is kept for 48 h after the switch as a rollback target that loses no changes.
